page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at right; a framed oval engraved portrait with circular legend around it; below the portrait a four-line Latin verse caption; a signature mark at lower right below the verse.

main_text.l: LAMORALIUS COMES DE EGMOND, PRINCEPS GAVERA, ETC.
Nec me divitiæ, nec avita gloria gentis,
Obsequia & sincerus amor, nec bellica virtus
Insignesque animi, quos fortis Gallia sensit,
Inter ere, hostili cecidit capùt ense recisum.

page.notes: The legend around the portrait is partly curved and set in capitals; it is transcribed as read, with some letters uncertain. The fourth verse line is hard to read in the scan: "Inter ere" and "capùt" and "ense recisum" are doubtful. The engraving itself is described here only; it is not transcribed as text.
